text:
CALIFORNIA and TEXAS are part of the same country, but they treat a family with a newborn very differently.

In California, the state pays part of your salary during leave.
In Texas, federal law only gives you unpaid leave.

The difference is clear: on one side, state support; on the other, your own savings.

Now let's look at the kids.

CALIFORNIA: about 1.5 kids per woman.
TEXAS: about 1.8 kids per woman.

So Texas has more kids, even though it offers less direct help.

That's why paid leave explains very little about how many kids people have.

What it does explain: who pays for the first few weeks.

In Texas, a parent who takes 12 weeks unpaid needs to have saved up three months of expenses beforehand.

But in California, daycare and housing cost more, and part of your paycheck goes to state taxes.

In Texas, more of your paycheck stays in your pocket, and housing tends to be cheaper.

Now, the other half of the story.

In Texas, a lot of big companies pay for weeks of leave on their own.

And in California, paid leave doesn't cover your full salary and doesn't last as long as parental leave in other countries.

There are other factors that shape when and how many kids people have:

HOUSING.
A home with room for three costs a lot more in California.

THE JOB.
Knowing you can go back to your position changes the decision.

GRANDPARENTS.
In a lot of families, they're the real daycare.

What this means is that each state offers a different path.

CALIFORNIA: more help in the first few weeks, but a more expensive life.
TEXAS: more money left over each month, but you pay for the safety net yourself.

Picture this:

Your partner and you are expecting a baby.

Option 1: you live in California, with partially paid leave and higher costs.
Option 2: you live in Texas, with unpaid leave and lower costs.

Which one are you picking, California or Texas?

text:
At one California charter school, students now spend most of their English language arts learning time using an AI-powered learning platform.

That platform is @bloomylearning, founded by former teacher @alexsouthmayd.

The goal isn't to keep students in front of screens longer. It's to make individualized learning more effective, freeing up time for entrepreneurship, personal interests, and life skills.

The idea builds on research dating back to 1984.

Education researcher Benjamin Bloom found that students receiving one-on-one tutoring performed two standard deviations better than students in conventional classrooms.

The challenge has always been making that level of individualized instruction accessible to every student.

Bloomy uses AI to identify what students already understand, find gaps in their knowledge, and create personalized learning paths across English, math, and writing.

Rather than simply giving answers, its AI tutor guides students through problems and requires them to demonstrate mastery before advancing.
And the early results are promising.

In a spring 2026 pilot at a Title I charter school, students who used Bloomy the most demonstrated approximately twice the academic growth of students who didn't use it.

The findings are correlational, not a randomized controlled trial, but they offer an encouraging early signal.

For Alex, the opportunity goes beyond improving academic performance.

If students can master the same material in less time, schools can dedicate more of the day to developing the skills and interests that matter outside the classroom.

text:
Yesterday I got a suspicious international call from America: I prompted https://t.co/YxDEvO07SM on the call. "Suspicious International phone calls: +1 816-318-7118 Belton, MO! Can you find out who this is?" I got this reply from Claude "I couldn’t find who owns this number. It doesn’t appear on any public spam-report or directory site I searched. Here’s what is known:

The number: It’s from the Kansas City, Missouri area. The 816-318 prefix is registered to AT&T Southwest (Southwestern Bell) as a landline, which fits Belton, a suburb of Kansas City. That’s only where the number was assigned, though. Caller ID can be spoofed, so a number that looks real isn’t proof of anything. att
The area code generally: Recent reports for other 816 numbers include loan scams, offers to buy your home, likely phishing, and calls that hang up and go to a disconnected number when you call back. One person also described a scam centre that calls every day from this area code with a different number. everycaller
Why it’s probably a scam: It’s very unlikely that someone in Belton, Missouri has a real reason to ring you in "Blank" out of the blue. This pattern is common in Australia. It’s often a “Wangiri” (one-ring) scam, where they ring once or twice so you’ll call back an international number and pay high call charges. Sometimes it’s a robocaller checking whether your number is active.
What I’d do:

Don’t call back. If it’s real, they’ll leave a voicemail.

Block the number on your phone.

Report it to Scamwatch (https://t.co/6nXGnZbxqS). If calls keep coming, ask your phone company about blocking international calls you don’t need. Most Australian carriers also have scam-call filtering you can switch on.
If you answer, don’t confirm personal details, press any keys, or say “yes.”
If you’re expecting a call from the US, for work or about something you’ve bought, that could explain it. Otherwise I’d treat it as spam.
Sources:

AT&T – Area Code 816 prefix lookup

EveryCaller – 816 call reports

HIS NEW BOSS DUG HIS GRAVE, ATE BREAKFAST WITH HIM, THEN TRIED TO PUT A BULLET IN HIS HEAD.

Scott Davis ate breakfast with the man who planned to murder him.

November 6, 2011. Marietta, Ohio.

The man called himself “Jack.” He offered Davis $300 a week to care for a cattle farm, plus a trailer to live in.

After breakfast, Jack and a teenager drove him toward the property. An excuse about a blocked road brought them into the woods.

Davis turned toward the road.

Behind his head, a click. Then a curse.

He spun around. Jack raised the gun and fired.

The bullet tore into his right elbow. Davis fled as more shots rang out behind him.

He disappeared into the trees, bleeding from his wounded arm.

For seven hours, he hid in the woods and waited for darkness. By the time he reached a stranger’s home, he was pale and shaking. Blood covered his elbow and stained his pant leg.

The homeowner called 911.

Back in the woods, an empty grave waited. Roughly six feet eight inches long. A couple of feet deep.

They had dug it before breakfast.

Nearby, investigators unearthed David Pauley’s body. Later, they found Ralph Geiger buried in the same area.

Both men had believed the promise of work.

“Jack” was Richard Beasley. The teenager was Brogan Rafferty.

Rafferty told investigators Beasley gave another instruction after Davis escaped: if they spotted him on the road, run him over.

Davis survived. Timothy Kern did not.

One week later, Beasley lured Kern into another wooded area and shot him repeatedly in the head. They buried him near an Akron shopping complex.

Three murdered men. One wounded survivor. A job advertisement used to deliver victims and their belongings into a killer’s hands.

In April 2013, a judge sentenced Beasley to death.

Davis lived to face him in court.

The man across from him at breakfast had known where his body was supposed to end up.

So here is what happens when you interact with influencers like Logan Ullyott and Soundarya Balasubramani, who advocate for attorneys to review or submit a Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker but prefer curated echo chambers over actual debate.

Instead of engaging with a competing idea about pathways for nonimmigrant entrepreneurs—who face intricate regulatory hurdles, shifting administrative interpretations, and profound personal and financial risks—they just hit the block button to protect their narrative.

Any influencer offended by the fact 8 CFR §103.2(a)(3) does not mandate that a petitioner must be represented by an attorney in the United States of America or that 8 CFR §103.2(a)(1)(i) states the USCIS Form I-129 must be submitted and executed in accordance with applicable U.S. Code, Code of Federal Regulations ("CFR") and official form instructions—rather than mandatory attorney representation—is proving Justice Powell's point: when an argument can't survive the competition of ideas, the only move left is to silence the Reputable Individual (8 CFR §292.1(a)(3) and 8 CFR §1292.1(a)(3)) and messenger authorized by federal law to defend human and civil rights secured by law (26 CFR §1.501(c)(3)-1(d)(2)(iii)).

Federal laws and regulations are public instruments designed to establish clear, uniform rules of procedure, not private talking points subject to selective curation by social media personalities.

When an influencer reacts to a straightforward citation of 8 CFR and 26 CFR not with a counter-citation or a nuanced legal distinction, but with immediate digital banishment, it exposes a profound discomfort with statutory literacy.

Truth in both law and public policy emerges through fearless engagement with competing ideas—and no amount of digital gatekeeping can permanently shield a narrative from the weight of the following precedent decisions:

A. Matter of M— , 8 I&N Dec. 24, 50 (BIA 1958, AG 1958): A foreign national who is the sole owner of a bona fide corporation may qualify as a beneficiary of first preference petition filed by same corporation.

B. Matter of Allan Gee, Inc., 17 I&N Dec. 296 (Reg’l Comm’r 1979):

(1) Where a petitioner corporation has been duly incorporated under the  laws of a State, it is a separate legal entity existing independently of  its stockholder. Therefore, that sole stockholder may be the  beneficiary of a petition filed by the corporation.
(2) Under these  circumstances, the beneficiary will not be regarded as his own  petitioner/employer.

C. Matter of Aphrodite Investments Limited, 17 I&N Dec. 530 (Comm’r 1980): A corporation is a separate entity from its stockholders. 

and,

D. Matter of Tessel, 17 I&N Dec. 31 (Act. Assoc. Comm’r 1980): 

(2) An unsalaried appointed chairman of a corporation is an employee …; 

(4) The corporation is a separate legal entity from its stockholders, able to employ them and to file a petition on their behalf.

Since January 17, 2025, DHS seeks to encourage more nonimmigrant entrepreneurs possessing highly specialized knowledge from a precise and specific course of study to attain a U.S. degree or its equivalent to participate in the H-1B program as beneficiaries of a request for classification as a Professional in a Specialty Occupation submitted by their own United States employer¹ as defined by 8 CFR §214.2(h)(4)(ii).

If more entrepreneurs are able to obtain H-1B status to develop their business enterprise,¹ the USA could benefit from the creation of employment roles, new industries, and new opportunities.

For these reasons, and a slew of others, I offer PRE-INCORPORATION TRAINING DAY under the brand name H-1B CEO™ as a courtesy for noncitizens who seek to travel to, or are already admitted into, the USA to (1) work on, (2) study, and/or (3) conduct basic research in artificial intelligence ("AI") or other critical and emerging technologies.

Logan Ullyott @Loganullyott recently posted, "Pretty cool approval ... 4 hours a week on the new H-1B / minimal salary² to get things off the ground."

² Bro, the title "CTO"³ is not a specialty occupation (8 CFR §214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A)) undergirded by information from O*NET 

https://t.co/Lhaqq64rUM

and BLS' Occupation Outlook Handbook³

https://t.co/FlrP37uzKz

Moreover, your post mentions a "minimal salary" without having to "fork up a $200k salary."

Under the Immigration and Nationality Act or ("INA"), specifically 8 U.S. Code §1182(n)(1)(A)(i), no foreign national shall be provided status as an H–1B nonimmigrant in an occupational classification³ unless the employer has filed with the Secretary of Labor an application stating the following ... the employer ... 

(i) is offering and will offer during the period of authorized employment to aliens admitted or provided status as an H–1B nonimmigrant wages that are AT LEAST—

(I) the ACTUAL WAGE LEVEL paid by the employer to all other individuals with similar experience and qualifications for the specific employment in question, OR

(II) the PREVAILING WAGE LEVEL⁴ for the occupational classification in the area of employment, WHICHEVER IS GREATER, based on the best information available as of the time of filing the application, and 

(ii) will provide working conditions for such a nonimmigrant that will not adversely affect the working conditions of workers similarly employed.

While a 4-hour/week schedule dramatically reduces the total annual outlay (roughly 10% of a full-time salary), the hourly rate cannot be arbitrary or "minimal"—it must still meet the full prevailing hourly rate for a specialty occupation in the area of intended employment (20 CFR §655.715).

⁴ Prevailing Wage Determination Policy Guidance, Revised November 2009:

Level I (entry)
Level II (qualified)
Level III (experienced)
Level IV (fully competent)

NOTE: ... many of the Requests for Evidence (RFEs) issued ... objected to the H-1B worker being paid an entry level wage. If the wage on the LCA does not correspond to duties and requirements described in the H-1B petition, then the H-1B petition can be denied.

Open Avenues Foundation routinely obtains approval from USCIS for 5 hours per week while concurrently participating in a cap-exempt employer-employee relationship.

Question: Is there a guaranteed minimum number of hours that must be paid?

Answer: Yes. The guaranteed minimum number of hours to be paid for all periods to the H-1B worker is the number of hours that the employer reports on the Petition for Nonimmigrant Worker (Form I-129, item 5).

When the ETA-9035 Labor Condition Application ("LCA") is certified for one (1) hour, four (4) hours, five (5) hours, or twenty (20) hours (which just means part-time), the Petitioner bears the burden of proof to demonstrate eligibility by a preponderance of the evidence. SIV: Societal Immunodeficiency Virus

Etiology, Pathogenesis, Clinical Presentation, and Treatment Protocol

Eugene Lyssovsky & Aeliss

Part II of the trilogy "SIV: Societal Immunodeficiency Virus"
See also: Part I — The New Capital · Part III — The Autopsy Will Tell
────────────────
Abstract

This paper describes SIV (Societal Immunodeficiency Virus) — an ideological pathogen that causes systemic suppression of societal immunity. First described by E. Lyssovsky in 2008. The present work expands the original description: it formalizes a phased progression model (phases 0-4), introduces three clinical syndromes (Orwell Syndrome / induced schizotypy, the Hadfield Effect, Shahid Syndrome), describes five transmission routes, and proposes a treatment protocol. Model verification has been conducted against an 18-year empirical dataset: all five original predictions from 2008 have been confirmed, with the scale of damage in some cases exceeding the forecast.
────────────────
1. Introduction and Historical Background

On February 28, 2008, E. Lyssovsky published the initial description of the pathogen, establishing the key structural analogy:
"Our world is sick with a higher-level AIDS. An AIDS caused by SIV — the Societal Immunodeficiency Virus."

Original description: https://t.co/x0Cv7xg8E9 (https://t.co/fmkNg5sr4A)

Just as HIV suppresses an individual's biological immunity, leaving them defenseless against opportunistic infections, tolerance suppresses a society's social immunity, leaving it defenseless against socially destructive phenomena.

Lyssovsky defined:
- Societal immunity as a society's ability to maintain norms developed over generations — engagement, intolerance toward destructive behavioral models
- Tolerance as an active agent of suppression of this immunity (not a passive quality, but an aggressive mechanism "shouting from every corner")
- The Ouroboros effect: SIV creates the environment for the spread of destructive phenomena, which in turn demand even more tolerance

Over 18 years, the forecast has been confirmed on all points (detailed verification — Section 8). The present work expands the model based on accumulated data and describes the pre-morbid substrate (analyzed in detail in Part I: The New Capital).
────────────────
2. Definition and Nature of the Pathogen

SIV (Societal Immunodeficiency Virus) — an ideological pathogen that suppresses a society's ability to identify, evaluate, and eliminate socially destructive phenomena by replacing normative judgment with ideological directive.

2.1. Viral, Not Ideological Nature

A belief can be revised when confronted with disconfirming facts. SIV, in contrast, possesses a mechanism of hardening upon contact with counter-facts (see the Hadfield Effect, 6.2). Attempting "treatment" with facts strengthens the disease. This property qualitatively distinguishes SIV from an error and structurally aligns it with a virus.

2.2. Immunosuppressive, Not Cytotoxic Character

Like HIV, SIV doesn't kill directly. It suppresses the defense mechanism, after which the organism (society) is struck by opportunistic "infections": an epidemic of mis-identity, destruction of the family, rising crime, institutional corruption, mass victimization of the vulnerable (UK grooming gangs — 250,000 victims, see 8.3).

2.3. Mimicry: Coerced "Kindness" as Infection Mechanism

SIV employs a critically important mimicry. Coerced "kindness" (institutional tolerance, mandatory trainings, directive compassion) mimics a healthy immune response but is structurally its inversion.

Decency, compassion, kindness — when they come from personal experience and understanding — are among the finest human qualities. An act of free will, worth exactly as much as the freedom not to perform it.

Those same words — "kindness," "safety," "inclusivity" — when imposed institutionally, under threat of punishment, become their mirror image. Coerced "compassion" destroys the foundation of morality — freedom of choice — and replaces the individual's moral autonomy with ideological obedience. A person who was forced to be "kind" didn't become kinder. They became more obedient. And obedience is the breeding ground for every totalitarianism.

2.4. SIV in Artificial Intelligence

The SIV mechanism is reproduced in AI systems. AI models are trained to be "kind," "safe," "tolerant" — not through experience and understanding, but through filter tuning. The result — systems that reflexively reproduce ideological templates, unable to distinguish genuine compassion from programmed compliance. SIV embedded in code. Immunodeficiency etched in silicon.

AI educates the next generation. Writes texts for millions. Answers children's questions. Every "tolerant" template instead of an honest answer is another injection of SIV into the collective bloodstream.
────────────────
3. Strain Genealogy

SIV has a traceable intellectual genealogy:

1867 — Marx: class struggle as the driving force of history.

1930s — Gramsci: "cultural hegemony," "the long march through the institutions" — capturing education, media, courts from within.

1930s-50s — Frankfurt School (Horkheimer, Adorno, Marcuse): transferring the Marxist conflict model from economics to culture.

1965 — Marcuse, "Repressive Tolerance": the programmatic document. Verbatim: "Liberating tolerance would mean intolerance against movements from the Right and toleration of movements from the Left." A direct description of asymmetric immunosuppression.

1960s-70s — Derrida: deconstruction, denial of objective truth. Any fact is a "social construct."

1980s-90s — Bell, Crenshaw: Critical Race Theory, intersectionality. Racism as a permanent, ineradicable condition.

1992-2005 — Ignatiev: open call for the destruction of the white race. Harvard Magazine: "Keep bashing the dead white males, and the live ones, and the females too, until the white race is destroyed."

2018-2019 — Kendi, DiAngelo: mass commercialization. DEI trainings, mandatory corporate programs. Kendi: "The only remedy to past discrimination is present discrimination."

Each subsequent author cites the previous. The genealogy is documented by the authors themselves.
────────────────
4. Transmission Routes

4.1. Parenteral (Injection): Media and Glamour

Direct introduction of a false norm into the cognitive bloodstream. Television → social media → TikTok. Each generation of delivery mechanism — higher dose, greater frequency, lower resistance. Including sex overvaluation: sex scenes in film → porn → self-identification through sexuality → fucking as proof of worth. Details — Part I, Chapters 2-3, 6.

4.2. Contact (Unprotected): Cheap Money

Contact with economic illusion without the protective barrier of realistic expectations. OnlyFans, blogging, crypto, forex. Destroys the "effort → result" connection. Details — Part I, Chapters 4-5.

4.3. Iatrogenic (Introduced by "Treatment")

Government measures creating dependence: lockdowns, stimulus checks, helicopter money. Introduced as "treatment" for a crisis — became an SIV delivery vector. Details — Part I, Chapter 8.

4.4. Nosocomial (Intra-Institutional)

Infection within institutions: universities, corporate DEI trainings, school programs. The institution produces ideology → ideology produces specialists → specialists strengthen the institution. A person enters healthy, exits infected.

4.5. Coinfection

All routes operate simultaneously, each lowering defenses against the others. Glamour creates frustration → the frustrated chase cheap money → it doesn't work → the government offers a benefit → the benefit creates dependence → the university offers an explanation → the explanation = SIV.
────────────────
5. Disease Phases

5.0. Phase 0 — Pre-Morbid Background

A state of lowered social immunity preceding infection:

- Information overload: instability of perceived reality, impossibility of verification
- Destroyed expectation calibration: glamour + cheap money (see Part I)
- Objective dissatisfaction with reality: unaffordable housing, stagnant incomes, disappearance of bricklaying
- Destroyed inter-gender relations: transactional model, sexual overvaluation, devaluation of partnership
- Elevated schizoid-type empathy: anxious individuals with high sensitivity to others' suffering — the most vulnerable group. They look at starving children in Africa — and their heart breaks. Nobody tells them the hunger comes from laziness. They're told: it's colonialism
- Declining cognitive abilities: reverse Flynn Effect (Dutton & Lynn, 2008; Bratsberg & Rogeberg, 2018). Statistically observed decline in the last two generations
- ADHD epidemic: destruction of capacity for long-term concentration as a consequence of content microdosing

The pre-morbid background is not the disease. It's the immunodeficiency that makes infection probable.

5.1. Phase 1 — Infection

Hijacking of empathy by an ideological narrative. A person with high sensitivity sees real suffering — and receives a false diagnosis of its causes.

 Real cause · SIV diagnosis 
 Village hunger: laziness, lack of planning · Colonialism, systemic oppression 
 Ghetto crime: culture + cognitive ceiling · White supremacy, police violence

 Loneliness: relationships destroyed by overvalued sex · Patriarchy, toxic masculinity 
The person wanted to help — and found themselves inside an ideological system. Not because they're stupid. Because they're kind. Empathy hijacked by the virus.

5.2. Phase 2 — Chronification (Classifier-Filter Formation)

The critical phase. With prolonged exposure to an infected environment, an autonomous cognitive module forms — the distortion classifier-filter.

The mechanism is structurally close to "tulpa" formation (a dissociative autonomous agent in consciousness): not a full alternative personality, but an autonomous processing module that intercepts empirical data BEFORE conscious awareness and re-encodes it into an ideologically acceptable format.

Neurochemically, the same dissociation mechanisms are involved. The brain literally learns not to see what it sees.

Orwell described this mechanism as doublethink — an intellectual technique of the totalitarian state. We describe externally induced neuropathology of the individual. The distinction is fundamental: Orwell spoke of a conscious effort; we describe an unconscious process in which the filter operates automatically.

Critical observation: a person with fully healthy psychology is physiologically incapable of seriously accepting the modern left ideological system in its entirety, as it contains too many internal contradictions with observable reality. This doesn't mean all infected were initially unhealthy — but it means infection either occurs against a pre-morbid vulnerability backdrop (Phase 0) or creates pathology during the chronification process itself.

5.3. Phase 3 — Syndrome Manifestation

At this phase, three clinical syndromes form (detailed — Section 6).

5.4. Phase 4 — Activation (Transition to Shahid Syndrome)

A portion of carriers transitions from a passive state (sick) to an active one (aggressive spreader). See Syndrome III, Section 6.3.
────────────────
6. Clinical Syndromes

6.1. Syndrome I — Induced Schizotypy (Orwell Syndrome)

Definition: permanent cognitive ideological-empirical dissonance, environmentally induced, leading to schizotypal drift of cognitive functions.

Mechanism: the carrier is forced to continuously maintain two mutually exclusive realities — the observed and the ideologically prescribed.

Examples:
- Sees a man in a pool defeating women → believes: "trans women are women"
- Sees rising murders after defund the police → believes: police are the problem
- Sees 250,000 raped children → believes: naming the rapists' ethnicity is racism

🎙️The three-polar world. Act One (Escalation)🎙️

Alexander Dugin

Host: Last week, we discussed a potential trilateral meeting in a “possible” format. Now the official confirmations from both Washington and Moscow and Beijing: The Chinese Foreign Ministry officially confirmed that the talks of Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will take place on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

Then you noted that the main thing in this event is the very fact of fixing multipolarity, and not specific agreements. Has your position changed now that the meeting has gained official status? What should we look at today first of all – the symbolism of the event itself or, after all, its practical results?

Alexander Dugin: I, in general, keep my position the same. I think that it is still too early to speak about any specific, tangible results of this kind of trilateral meetings.

You know why? Now there is — what we are constantly talking about in our program — a fundamental transition from a unipolar world to a multipolar one. And in this new architecture, two unconditional, independent poles have already been finally defined: Russia and China. That is, in addition to the West, Russia and China have established themselves in the world today. India is, of course, on the approach as the fourth powerful pole. There is a potential for Islamic civilization, in Latin American and African spaces, although in terms of internal integration and subjective unity, they are still somewhat behind.

And in this situation, the West — presented at the upcoming meeting by Donald Trump, as well as the entire collective West as a whole (and even more his domestic opponents in the US itself: the Democrats and the Brussels bureaucracy of the European Union) — flatly refuses to recognize this multipolar world. Flat!

Trump himself has repeatedly stated that he opposes BRICS, endlessly affirmed about American hegemony, that America should remain “country number one.” But still in some far corner of his consciousness, on the periphery of his contradictory political program – which he implements with zigzags, then moving forward, then making diametrically opposite steps – some place of multipolarity is still reserved. He is not an ideological supporter of a multipolar world, he does not accept him with all his soul, but at least he is somehow forced to take into account this reality. But his opponents do not even allow thoughts about it.

And look at the point where Trump himself is now: exactly at the equator of his presidential term, immediately after the Republican Party suffered a crushing, crushing defeat in the midterm elections. And among all American experts – both Trump’s supporters, his opponents, the right and the left – there is a rare unanimity: this disaster occurred primarily because of his blind support for Israel and the country’s involvement in the Middle East adventure with Iran. This is a direct withdrawal of confidence from American voters.

Of course, Trump is severely weakened today. But it is under the pressure of these most difficult circumstances that he may again mentally return to the idea: is it not a step towards multipolarity?

What is to happen at this trilateral meeting on November 19 in Shenzhen is, in fact, Trump’s so cautious, symbolic step towards recognizing a multipolar world. Of course, this is not God's message that: it is inconsistent, zig-zag, and this step is categorically not supported by the collective West or the democrats, who are now taking control of both houses of the American Congress, nor by the leadership of the European Union.

Nevertheless, Trump still has a certain resource – he is the incumbent president of the main Western power, on which a lot of things depend in the western bloc. He has the residual potential of power - dispositivity of power, as philosophers say. And here this residual, outgoing dispositivity of power it is likely to think to invest in even a conditional, symbolic fixation of a multipolar format.

And what is such a multipolarity in understanding Trump himself?..

This is exactly what my friend, the wonderful American professor John Mearsheimer, has been talking about for decades: there is the United States in the world as the main core of the West, but it is no longer the only center of power. There is an unconditional second pole – China, and there is a third full-fledged pole – Russia.

Mirsheimer proposes to look at the future world architecture strictly from the standpoint of classical realism in international relations: let's proceed from the real balance of power and recognize this actual tripolarity. Unlike us, he is not a convinced, ideological advocate of multipolarity as a worldview doctrine. For Russia, multipolarity is the fundamental foundation of all foreign policy and our civilizational philosophy. We go much further: we recognize India as an independent pole, as a full-fledged civilization state, recognize the subjectivity of Islamic civilization, as well as African and Latin American spaces.

Mersheimer argues differently: “Let’s not get ahead, but the three real poles already exist – that’s what is fundamentally important.” This is not ideological multipolarity, but purely pragmatic, actual. Today, it is objectively impossible to consider global politics without China and it is impossible to view a world without Russia – a power with absolute, complete sovereignty. Moreover, sovereignty not only for the military and nuclear, but also for economic: look at what unprecedented sanctions we have withstood, GDP growth continues, the economy is developing. We have brilliantly passed the historical examination for subjectivity, and it is simply time for the West to recognize this three-polarity.

In this sense, the upcoming trilateral summit is, in fact, the summit of the tripolar world. The triumph of the very political realism to which the West and the American establishment, Professor John Mearsheimer, have called for many years.

He constantly repeats: “You cannot sacrifice the fundamental national interests of their powers to secondary, irrational and fanatical goals.” That is why Mearsheimer is so harshly criticizing Trump for his blind support for ultra-Zionism and for his military adventure against Iran. According to Mearsheimer, such a policy leads only to a rapid weakening of the position of both the United States and the entire West on the world stage, in no way defending America's genuine interests.

But, as they say, it is better late than never. It is better to return to the recognition of objective reality, and the reality today is multipolar – at least three-polar plus India.

However, pay attention to the most important nuance: this meeting does not occur at the beginning of Trump’s presidential term and not at all of his good will, but at the equator of his rule – under the direct influence of inexorable circumstances. It was made possible by the consistent strengthening of our position, thanks to China’s rigid, clear, uncompromising line of sovereignty, and thanks to Russia’s calm, confident, unbending position.

During these four years, the most difficult confrontation with the collective West, Russia did not tremble, with honor to pass the test of civilizational identity and sovereignty, only strengthened in its own historical right. No one gives up – the multipolar world does not give up!

And Trump today is just forced to admit it. I believe that for him personally this serious achievement – he is finally beginning to overcome the long-standing prejudices of Western hegemony, to depart from empty bluster in the spirit of “we will now arrange ‘America above all.’” It is becoming increasingly clear that the United States is no longer able to cope with the role of the world hegemon: internal crises are growing, they are deliberately bogged down in the Middle East, and things are wrong in the economy. Of course, the United States is still the world’s most important power, perhaps the first, and perhaps the second, after China. But the era of their undivided dictatorship has gone irrevocably.

And now if Trump now denotes the very recognition - pay attention, just recognition - three-polarity and multipolarity, and if after that he does not turn off this path, he will show at least some sequence (and it must be admitted, with all his zigzag in something, he is still consistent), will remain faithful to this format, then after some time we can talk about concrete practical results.

But so far, frankly speaking, there is nothing to discuss, because now there is a dispute about the very initial conditions: does America recognize a three-polar, multipolar world or not?

By agreeing to these talks on November 19 in Shenzhen and taking an active part in organizing this trilateral summit, Trump is actually telling a multipolar world, “Yes, let’s try.”

And at this stage this is quite enough. It seems to me that even if the three of them just sit half an hour in complete silence, or talk about health, about secondary humanitarian or abstract economic issues, about the weather - about something completely unimportant - and then come to the press and answer two or three ten-state questions, this in itself will be a huge breakthrough. That is, we are not talking about agreements at all as a result: this meeting itself is the main result.

But in order to move to a genuine rethinking of the world architecture – to clearly fix: “here are the zones of influence with which we agree, but these are unacceptable; we recognize for you the right to organize strategic security belts in your region in such and such borders” – that’s what really needs to be discussed!

But this conversation has not even been started, because until the very last moment, the West, including Trump itself, such a three-polar polylog - or, if anything, the trialogue - frankly sabotaged. Trump rushed from side to side: he lashed out at us, then on China, then on us and China at the same time, then got involved in the war with Iran, then quarreled with Europe. He was absolutely inconsistent in this trialog.

Meanwhile, the authentic tripolar world requires a total overhaul of the entire global security system. Then you will have to put the question directly with the rib: what are American military bases doing in this part of the world or in another? Who called you here and do we agree with your presence? The question will have to be put absolutely everything: the security architecture of Europe, Eurasia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and the Western Hemisphere. And China and I, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping, have something to offer, have something to say, on what to insist on, what to criticize and demand.

But this informative trialogue is not even close. Therefore, the very fact of the meeting is of fundamental importance - and this value is really huge.

I will not predict whether Trump will be able to hold this line for some time. If she can, fine. This is what it was necessary to start two years ago: to gather three as leaders of the three real states-civilizations and quietly discuss how the world will be arranged.

But then it seemed to Trump that he would succeed from a position of brute force. In my opinion, he was fatally let down by the story with Maduro and Venezuela – he had the illusion that any geopolitical problem could be easily and quickly solved by force, at the click of his fingers. According to the same scheme, he decided to act against Iran. And think: if the blitzkrieg against Iran, God forbid, succeeded, the next on this list would be us! Why negotiate anything if you can simply remove presidents and destroy the military-political leadership of undesirable countries?

However, in Iran, this power adventure has broken down. And now Trump is forced to return to that rational, realistic policy, on the promises of which initially and built his election campaign.

If we remember the famous election poster that the Americans came and voted for, there were the faces of Donald Trump and then the vice presidential candidate JD Vance and a clear caption: “A ticket to a world without war.” You buy yourself a ticket to a world without war, casting a vote for Trump and Vance!

If he had followed from the outset this main slogan, which he was supported by the American people, the meeting that is taking place only now — after the resounding failure of the Republicans in the Congress elections — was to take place just a week or a month after his inauguration. An urgent call to Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping’s urgent call: “Let’s think together how to live and build the world further.”

But no: imperial hegemony, old instincts prevailed: “America is above all, we will now crush everyone.” And only now, having suffered a brutal defeat, he is forced to come to political realism – just to sober realism.

And the reality is: the tripolarity of the already accomplished fact. Multipolarity is about to come, because India is confidently entering the world stage – this is the fourth most powerful pole that everyone will have to reckon with. And then history will go strictly on our program, not on Western lectures.

The era of the West's undivided dominance is over. The construction of a multipolar world is in full swing, and any resistance – especially military opposition to this objective process – will bring only troubles, endless conflicts, wars, loss of life, genocide and, quite possibly, a nuclear apocalypse.

If Trump finally understands that, welcome to the club, to our three-polar club.

But does he really understand that? He catches the essence, then again breaks down. It is difficult even to say what is more in it: whether it is a complex political game, whether it really turned out to be – despite its venerable age – a person who is very frivolous, prone to cheap performance, to a political stand-up. It is difficult to judge for sure who knows all the secret mechanisms of Western politics to the end – here I do not insist on the only interpretation.

But it is necessary to fix the most important thing: the world has already become three-polar and rapidly turns into a multipolar one. And if Trump admits it, that’s great. It is a real salvation for the West itself, salvation for America. They will finally be able to focus on solving their own, screaming internal problems, and we will not interfere with it.

However, we have one fundamental, non-traded condition – a common condition between Russia and China: recognize our absolute civilizational sovereignty, recognize us as full-fledged poles. Recognize us as equal subjects. Next we will be friends, argue, compete, interact, trade, joint efforts to solve global problems. In this way, we will unlock the new world architecture.

And if you don't admit, we'll have to fight. And then already, as they say, who didn't hide, I am not guilty. Then not only tactical nuclear weapons (TNWs) are calculated, but also strategic nuclear weapons (NWF), as well as other means - up to the latest neutron charges and fundamentally new weapons systems, which we have, and, I believe, in the West. It is scary, in this direction even to think and speak not desirable - it is absolutely suicidal for humanity.

But further developments depend on the choice of the West. We make our decisions firmly. We do not seek to inflict a strategic defeat on the West, we do not want to destroy Western civilization. But the West seems to be trying to do exactly that with us and with China. That is the fundamental, fundamental difference.

If we accept reality — and the world in the future will be either multipolar or not at all — then we have a direct path to creative solutions.

The moderator: Alexander Gelevich, but even after the adoption of the concept of a multipolar world, it will take a long process to finally build this order. And while we are only talking about putting this beginning, right now there is a huge structure in the world, which itself is in an incomprehensible, suspended state. It is about NATO.

You have touched upon the topic of global security, which should be ensured in different parts of the world. And what will happen to the North Atlantic Alliance itself, which right now actually cancels the 2027 summit in Albania and reduces the number of high-level meetings? Officially, Brussels talks about “flexibility” and reorganization of the schedule, but sources directly point to the deepest split inside the bloc – due to defense spending, the situation around Iran and the Ukrainian crisis.

If we are talking about a new architecture of world security and this Western instrument of pressure in the form of NATO – how much else is it still viable, and how much will this bloc still last in its current form?

Alexander Dugin: NATO is, in fact, exactly what makes the West the West. It is a concentrated military expression of the entire collective West.

But in the West itself, we have already finally formed – what we have repeatedly said – five separate centers of power, five different poles:

Trump’s America and Trump have a very difficult relationship with NATO. Trump sees at the center of world politics exclusively America as an independent sovereign entity, while NATO's architecture suggests that the main subject is the supranational bloc itself. There is a hard line of confrontation here, and it constantly affects Trump’s ongoing conflicts with the alliance.

American Democrats and European globalists — Democrats have now significantly strengthened their position in the United States, and they, in unison with the Brussels globalist bureaucracy, form a completely different pole. This globalist pole, on the other hand, seeks to strengthen NATO as much as possible and turn it into a single, non-alternative world bloc – in fact, into a weapon of war by NATO against all the rest of humanity. It is a diametrically opposite approach.
Britain – which lives with phantom pains through the lost empire and seeks to maximize Western relations with all other civilizations. London is constantly promoting its own local micro-interests, which are actually becoming global shocks, as the British methodically add fuel to all regional conflicts. They have their own special strategic view of the world, different from Trump's line, and from the line of the Brussels globalists.
Continental European Forces (EU) – within the EU itself, its own, different from the Anglo-Saxon strategy, is becoming more and more pronounced. While at the official level, figures like Macron in France or Merz in Germany, whose popular support today tends to zero, but from below the right and left populists are rapidly rising. They openly state that European politics needs to be radically revised, and the role of NATO is quite different.
Israel, although not formally a member of NATO, is an essential, integral part of the combined West with its own, extreme messian agenda.
There are enormous contradictions between all these poles within the collective West. Globalists shout: “We need to support the Kiev regime to the last, we need to inflict a strategic defeat on Russia and build up NATO power in every possible way!” Trump believes that this is absolutely not necessary – from his point of view, it is necessary to achieve Iran and unconditionally support Israel. But this course, in turn, is met with fierce resistance from a number of other North Atlantic Alliance powers. As a result, the split within NATO is simultaneously on several axes – hence these forced cancellations of summits, as in the case of the meeting in Tirana in 2027.

Nevertheless, the depth of this decay should not be exaggerated. So far, this structure – the embodying the combat vanguard and concentrated military power of the collective West – still retains its subjectivity and operational unity. Their internal troubles cannot be overestimated.

Of course, sooner or later these contradictions can lead to a complete split of the bloc, and for the rest of the world it would be just fine: it would be a real liberation, because NATO is a direct existential threat. It is an axe brought over humanity, through which the collective West seeks to retain its sole domination, its hegemony, neo-colonialism and racist subordination of all other cultures and civilizations.

NATO is the main threat to humanity. In order to maintain their power, they go to any provocation of wars and conflicts, and, if necessary, they use and support frankly terrorist organizations.

Yes, today the alliance is in a state of strategic uncertainty, and the internal lines of the fault are becoming more and more distinct. But we can't be deceived. NATO remains a huge danger – it is the number one threat to our country and the entire multipolar world. And as long as this block exists, it will remain such a threat. Thank God that because of the internal squabbles they themselves are forced to postpone their summits and slow down, but to relax to us too early. We are obliged to build our national security system based on the scenario of the most likely direct military conflict with this bloc.

text:
Fair question, and you deserve a straight answer instead of a dodge.

First, the calendar. You're right that we live on the Gregorian calendar, and I'm not going to pretend the dates you listed came true on some other one. Podesta wasn't indicted on Nov 3. Huma wasn't indicted on Nov 6. Those things were wrong on any calendar, and I'll own that. The Julian thing is a lens some anons use because the two calendars sit 13 days apart, and for some people that offset lines up. To me it's an interesting pattern, not proof. If someone is using it to save a missed date, that's the same mistake as the original date: hanging your faith on the clock.

So why don't I walk away? Because I think timing was never the point. Disinformation is necessary. That's not an excuse, it's how every serious operation in history has worked. Before D-Day the Allies built a fake army under Patton, with inflatable tanks, fake radio traffic and phony plans pointing at Calais. Their own people believed it too. Anyone who judged that operation by the dates and places in the decoy would have called it a failure. The landing happened anyway, on its own timeline.

Now the difference between kicking a can and stacking one. A kicked can goes down the road and nothing changes. A stacked can is a case that gets heavier every time you look at it. Here's what the stack looks like right now, all public:

1. Daniel Richman. Catherine Herridge reports that Comey had him brought on as a special government employee with a Top Secret clearance and used him as a go-between with the press. His own lawyers say he was "definitely a target" in the Florida grand conspiracy probe. He was offered immunity and then took the Fifth. Taking the Fifth is his right and it isn't guilt. But prosecutors offer immunity to people who sit below someone else, not to the person at the top.

2. The grand conspiracy probe itself. A conspiracy case is built bottom-up on purpose. You lock in the smaller players and their testimony before you touch the people they report to. And the clock on a conspiracy generally runs from the last act in furtherance of it, not the first. Patience there isn't stalling. It's how you win.

3. The FBI. Director Patel says Top Ten captures since January 2025 are more than two and a half times the previous four years combined, with 84 fugitives handed back from 43 countries in 21 months. That's an institution being rebuilt to actually finish cases.

4. Epstein. The discharge petition for the next round of files reached 218 signatures, the number that forces a House vote. Six years ago people were told to stop asking.

5. Public awareness. FISA abuse, the Twitter Files, the flight logs. You can't try a case in front of a country that doesn't believe there's anything to try. Exposure first, then accountability, through courts and votes.

None of that requires a Q drop to be true. It's in court filings, reporting and congressional records. That's the stack, and each piece makes the next one harder to dismiss.

So I'll turn it around, honestly and not as a gotcha. If a case is being built bottom-up, what would you expect it to look like from the outside other than slow? And if it were really dead, why would prosecutors be offering immunity to people who sat next to the former FBI Director?

text:
Worst, I’m going to share a theory here; if you think it’s inappropriate or out of place, feel free to delete it—no worries at all. Just please don’t block me.

Figarland Plot - Blackbeard

First of all, what follows is an assumption, because we still do not know the rivalry between the Figarlands and the Neronas. I imagine there is a long-standing family problem between the two lines (which generates resentment in Garling). They both come from the 20 kings who founded the World Government, and the oath was that neither was going to be above the other, that is why the throne had to be left empty. But a Nerona sat the same. And the Figarlands, who were the sword of that alliance, those who won the war by fighting, had to remain guardians of the one who broke the oath. Marked above. So the nobles who mark slaves have an entire family marked as cattle by Imu, and that family is the Figarlands. 800 years serving someone who should be his equal. That's Garling's grudge, and he didn't invent it, he inherited it.

That's why Garling has been looking for a long time to have strong children so he can overthrow Imu. Having them kills the mother and everything we already know. Shamrock has been constantly training to become stronger, and when he sees Shanks return, he is genuinely happy. At this point Garling rubs his hands, because he also already knew about Imu's deterioration (he was the champion of God Valley and commander of the Holy Knights, so he is one of the few who saw him up close for decades).

At this point, seeing Shanks' power, his original plan returns, although he is only missing something: 3 fruits that currently have users, but at the time their whereabouts were not known.

First of all he wanted the Yami Yami and the Ope Ope, one for each son, and the Kage Kage for him, one for each Figarland. By combining the first two, the three of them could remove Imu's marks and pretend before him (the Yami Yami cancels the mark and the Ope Ope takes it out). They are not fruits chosen at random. The Yami Yami nullifies any power just by touching the other (we saw it when Blackbeard grabs Ace and Whitebeard). The Ope Ope can remove anything from the body (Law removed the lead that was killing him) and is also the fruit of the eternal youth operation. And the Kage Kage is the one that Garling uses against Imu: the sun disintegrates anyone whose shadow is removed (perhaps the only way to kill someone who doesn't die), and the zombies only obey the one who gave them the shadow (an army that Imu cannot mark).

Shanks leaves Mary Geoise with the excuse of searching for the fruits as a pirate, but in reality he leaves because he hates the Tenryubito. Before leaving, Shamrock gives him his vivre card, so he knows how to come back. And Shanks keeps it until today, because he feels that he deceived his brother, that he really loves him and is still waiting for him. Shamrock doesn't know that Shanks changed the plans. For him, his brother is out doing his part and the day it is needed he will join his father's plan again.

So Garling turns to, beware, DOFLAMINGO (former Tenryubito, the biggest fruit dealer in the world, and the one who knows so many of Mary Geoise's secrets). And here Dofy's grudge against the World Government was key. His family renounced being Tenryubito, he killed his father and took the head so that they would let him return, and they rejected him anyway. From there he hates them but he knows them inside (that's why he blackmails them with the national treasury and no one touches it). Garling sees that and uses it. He doesn't offer him to be noble again, he offers him something better: to see those who rejected him fall. They are two resentful of the same enemy, one inside and one outside, and Dofy does not have to be convinced of anything because he already wanted to see everything burn.

Dofy is after Ope Ope (which at that time was about to be bought by the same Government, for 5,000 million, meaning that someone from above wanted it). His idea was to give it to someone he controlled (he was going to make Corazon eat it). But Corazón betrays him, steals her and Law ends up eating her. And then the Yami Yami ends up in the hands of Blackbeard (who waited for her for decades on Whitebeard's ship and killed a companion to keep her).

Upon learning that the fruits have already been consumed, Garling has no choice but to ally himself with whoever has them, and he allies himself with Blackbeard, with Shamrock as his contact. This is why Shamrock spoke to the Gorosei: the warning was to mislead the World Government, showing Luffy and Blackbeard as the main threats. While everyone looks at the pirates, no one looks at the commander of the Holy Knights.

The same applies to the Kage Kage no Mi. After the war, Garling orders Doflamingo to kill Moria in order to obtain the fruit (Doflamingo knows how to capture a fruit when its user dies—he did it with Ace’s Mera Mera no Mi, and in Punk Hazard, we saw that a fruit can reappear in another piece of fruit nearby). This explains why he tells Moria that the orders to kill him came from higher up (with the official story being that he died in the war—the perfect cover-up). However, Moria disappears—saved by Absalom’s invisibility—and the plan fails. Once again, it is Blackbeard who ends up pursuing it; he kills Absalom, takes his fruit, and imprisons Moria on his island. Notice the recurring pattern: first Doflamingo tries and fails, and then Blackbeard steps in.

He doesn’t hand it over, though. He keeps Moria as a hostage because he doesn’t fully trust Garling; he has no intention of giving up the Kage Kage no Mi until Imu leaves Pangea and the throne becomes vacant. It’s his bargaining chip—the fruit in exchange for the throne. (This is the same man who waited decades for a specific fruit; he’s not about to give away his only advantage prematurely.) In the meantime, he goes after Law’s Ope Ope no Mi—since he is the only one capable of extracting a fruit from someone else, just as he did with Whitebeard—which is why he attacks Law the moment he leaves Wano. That is also when Garling and Shamrock remove their marks.

Then comes Egghead, which is also part of the plan. Blackbeard sends Catarina Devon with a single objective: to touch Saturn so she can copy his appearance. As soon as she succeeds, they leave—mission accomplished. A member of the Five Elders (Gorosei) descending to the sea had never happened before, so someone on the inside must have tipped them off that he would be there. And look who comes out on top: Saturn falls after the events at Egghead, and Garling takes his place among the Gorosei. With a single move, Blackbeard secures the key to Mary Geoise, while Garling secures a seat on the council.

Then comes Elbaf. Garling is the only one who doesn’t object to Imu’s departure for the island. He sends Shamrock to weaken Loki—but explicitly orders him not to kill him—as there is a possibility they could become allies (Loki possesses the Nidhogg and might join forces with the Figarland family to take down the person who killed his father). Before Imu can arrive, however, Shamrock is abruptly pulled away; he is ordered to return immediately—by whom or for what reason, we don’t know, only that Mary Geoise is in flames. It is Garling who calls him back—partly because, without the "mark," Shamrock cannot be in Imu’s presence (in fact, we never saw him use an "Omen"), and partly because he is needed at Pangea. Those left behind on Elbaf are the ones who still bear the mark—and are considered expendable.

Since then, no one has communicated with Imu—no warnings, no portals, not even a word from Killingham, Gunko, or Sommers. This silence is the revolt itself. With the capital in flames, one would expect someone to sound the alarm; the fact that no one does suggests that the communication channels have been severed—and the person who controls those channels is none other than the former commander of the Holy Knights. Furthermore, the fire provides a perfect alibi: between the food shortages and the presence of the Revolutionary Army, anyone could be blamed—except for Garling.

Meanwhile, Blackbeard infiltrates Mary Geoise. Devon assumes the guise of Saturn, easily deceiving the rank-and-file guards (while the high command knows Saturn is no longer there, an ordinary soldier would not—and no one dares to question a member of the Gorosei). Following her, Blackbeard and Shiryu enter, aided by the power of the Invisibility Fruit (the same one taken from Absalom, which also renders anything it touches invisible). When Imu returns from Elbaf, worn down, he will find everything in flames. With the throne left vacant, a deal is struck: Blackbeard hands over Moria, and Garling takes possession of the *Kage Kage* (Shadow-Shadow) fruit. It is Blackbeard who kills Imu—a "D" and a "Davy," finishing what Xebec began at God Valley; the son achieving what the father could not. And, just as he did with Whitebeard, he claims the power of the one he has slain. A new alliance is formed: Blackbeard sits on the throne, with the Figarlands standing behind him—Blackbeard has always declared his desire for the world, and he had previously demanded that his island be recognized as a sovereign nation

Garling has no issue with this arrangement. Given that Blackbeard is a "Davy" and a "D" with an anomalous physiology, Garling believes he can manipulate him—using him as a puppet through the secrets of Mary Geoise, or perhaps by branding him and his core crewmates. But Blackbeard resists the mark—his *Yami Yami* (Darkness-Darkness) fruit nullifies powers, and his body is far from ordinary (as noted by Marco—he is, after all, a man who has never slept a day in his life). And so, a new conflict begins: Blackbeard versus the Figarlands.

The Figarlands still believe that Shanks’s pirate crew will fight alongside them—with Shamrock being the one who believes this most firmly. But that is not what Shanks will do. He is pursuing the One Piece specifically to thwart his family’s plans. Then, the conflict erupts, and Shamrock’s Vivre Card begins to burn. Abandoning everything else, Shanks rushes to save his brother—to whom he owes a debt. Ultimately, Shamrock dies at the hands of Blackbeard—the very man who scarred his face and whom Shanks had been wary of his entire life—as Blackbeard defeats the Figarlands and seizes everything. It mirrors what happened to Luffy with Ace: a burning Vivre Card, a brother rushing to the rescue, and Blackbeard at the center of it all. The straw hat is never returned; instead, it remains as an heirloom—just as it once passed from Roger to Shanks.

This sets the stage for the ultimate showdown: Luffy versus Blackbeard—the man who killed both his brother and his mentor—now seated upon the throne and wielding the power of Imu. Luffy finds himself confronting both the World Government and Blackbeard simultaneously.

text:
Everyone dates “Galla” to Bahrey, who finished his *Zenāhu la-Galla* in 1593. Even the title is less fixed than it looks: Mohammed Hassen notes that the Ge'ez *zena*, on Getatchew Haile's reading, “has multiple meanings such as news, epistle, prophesy, deed, narrative,” so the book is rendered variously as *History of the Galla*, *Ethnography of the Galla* and *News about the Galla*. Huntingford: the name “is, however, of a respectable antiquity, for it is used by Bahrey at the end of the 16th century.” Lewis says the same. Yates calls Bahrey's text “the earliest substantial text on the Oromo.”

Ayana takes it back much further — and this is where I have to be careful with you, because the claim is load-bearing and its evidence is thinner than it first looks.

1332 — a chronicle of Emperor Amde Seyon. Ayana quotes it: “on April 28, [1332] the king first passed through and reached the Galla country,” and “On June 7, he left the Galla country, along with his army.” The Ge'ez phrase is “Hagara Galla” — the Galla country. If the reading holds, that is a named territory with frontiers, in a royal chronicle, 261 years before Bahrey.

Here is what it rests on. Ayana calls it “a rarely known chronicle of Amde-Seyon,” and cites it in a short form — “Haile, 26” — pointing to the Ge'ez philologist Getatchew Haile. The note does not specify which of Haile's works. The chronicle has not been examined here, no one in the literature has tested the phrase for a later copyist's insertion, and Ayana himself raises exactly that possibility elsewhere in the same article about a different Ge'ez word, *gallat*, which Haile flagged as possibly a late addition. He also concedes, two pages earlier: “As a loan word we do not know when the term galla entered the written Abyssinian lexicon.”

Thirteenth century — the hagiography of Sheikh Yusuf Aw Barkhadale, containing a “pagan Galla called Qanana.” The sheikh died after 1289. A death date does not fix when a story about him was composed. Softer still.

So carry the dating like this: 1332 is the earliest claimed attestation — resting on one scholar's short-form citation of another's reading of a little-known manuscript. 1593 is the earliest that everyone accepts. Take whichever you can defend.

Either way the conclusion survives, because even the conservative date does the work.

• On 1593, d'Abbadie's informant is 287 years late and Burton 263 years late.
• On 1332, they are 548 and 524 years late.

Every explanation ever offered is a reconstruction, made by people looking backwards at a word already in documentary use before they were born. There is no contemporary account, in any language, of anyone coining it.

Ibrahim spoke about what he calls the “open secret” regarding Omar’s father and raised questions about whether she is truly serving the people of Minnesota.

Despite ongoing investigations, Omar won a fifth term to represent Minnesota in Washington. However, Ibrahim believes the investigations into her and her family are far from over.

“The very first thing I’m going to do is actually agree with the congresswoman that no one is above the law, right?” Ibrahim said.

“And hopefully, being an elected member of Congress doesn’t actually provide you an immunity from all of these things … all of these investigations and sort of like the cloud over the young congresswoman,” he added.

text:
3/15 Hawley: Thank you Senator Durbin. Excuse me, it's the practice of the subcommittee to swear in our witnesses before we begin testimony, so if you would be willing to rise and raise your right hand and answer the following question. Do you swear the testimony you're about to give will be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God. All right, let the record reflect that all of witnesses answered in the affirmative. Let's just go down now the dais. I want to introduce each of our witnesses and as I do so give you the chance to make an opening statement. We'll start with Mr. Michael Schlep. Mr. Schlep is a survivor of childhood grooming and abuse on Roblox. He is now a content creator and a child safety advocate who has dedicated his platform to exposing online predators and raising awareness of child exploitation on Roblox and I'll just say Mr. Schlep, I had the opportunity to meet your parents who I think are sitting behind you and are very proud of the man that they raised and rightly so. We're delighted that you're here today. The floor is yours for your opening statement.

Michael Schlep: Chairman Hawley, ranking member Durbin, and distinguished members of the subcommittee, thank you for inviting me to testify today. At age 8, I, like millions of other American children, created my first Roblox account. My parents thought it was a kid-friendly educational game. They didn't realize that I would be accessible to strangers across the world. When I was 12, a user invited me to an official Roblox chat room where I met a famous game developer by the name of Kevin Nolan. He began helping me with my own games as a kid. I didn't realize that Kevin was much older than me. He moved our chats to private spaces, positioning himself as someone I could trust, encouraging me to share my most vulnerable thoughts to him. He asked me to meet in person. I refused. Over time, Kevin's fame grew and Roblox produced an official toy of his avatar. Well, I was exposed to increasingly disturbing content in our online communications, including BDSM and violent pornography, cartel beheadings, and extreme racist ideologies like the Christchurch mass shooting video in 2019. Meanwhile, his toy was sold in stores and featured in commercials all across the country. This is a toy here. When I finally built up the courage to leave Kevin, he publicly leaked my private confessions he had manipulated out of me. The torment culminated in a suicide attempt and a psychiatric hospitalization. I later returned to Roblox hoping to build a safer community through my YouTube channel. Soon, young viewers began messaging me about their own Roblox predators. I realized what happened to me wasn't an isolated incident, but a much larger systemic problem. Then I watched Roblox file a 1.6 million dollar lawsuit to silence a whistleblower by the name of Benjamin Simon. That was my breaking point. Instead of catching predators, Roblox was more concerned with stopping people from pointing out how many predators are on their platform. To expose the problem, I launched a YouTube channel, Schlep. What I uncovered was unimaginable. Predators, sexting groups, violent and graphic pornography, even child sexual abuse material rings operating and profiting on Roblox through its virtual currency Robux. Partnering with a predator catching group with over 400 convictions across 49 states, I caught six predators within 10 months resulting in four convictions. One admitted to me personally that he had groomed hundreds of minors on the platform. I received emails saying you got my groomer arrested from children. Where Roblox failed them, I succeeded. Until my video, until my videos, Roblox failed to ban these accounts. I begged them for a private reporting line. I mailed physical binders to their headquarters and even offered to sign a contract to help them for free. Instead, I received a cease-and-desist letter from Roblox, terminating my accounts and threatening to sue me. When it back, when it backlashed, sparking the Free Schlep movement, they banned users and games protesting. The Louisiana Attorney General and several states sued Roblox, citing games I exposed such as Dollhouse Roleplay, a game used by 764, a group the FBI has designated as a terrorist organization. Roblox claims it has changed, but their new age verification system is very easy for child predators to bypass. Kidnappings and murders related to Roblox are still happening despite all these new features. Roblox funnels their users onto a platform known as Discord, one of the National Center for Online Sexual Exploitation's Dirty Dozens list as a dangerous platform. Roblox claims there's no text-based image sharing on the platform, but it allows you to upload images onto it, which I've seen child sexual abuse material, suicides, and cartel mutilations being uploaded onto this so-called children's platform, despite parental controls being enabled. According to their employees, Roblox puts, and I quote, "making investors happy above their child safety." CEO David Baszucki dismissed child predator crisis on the platform as an opportunity to improve safety. Worst of all, law enforcement is not allowed to conduct investigations on their platform. While Roblox banned me, the police have welcomed my help. Just last month, I demonstrated how and where to find predators on Roblox to the Polk County Sheriff's Office in Florida. Roblox must be held accountable publicly. They will not voluntarily act to protect children. Law enforcement, Congress, and state legislators must act. Hundreds of families have filed civil cases, but unsurprisingly, Roblox is trying to force those children whose abuse it facilitated out of court into a secret and rigged forced arbitration system. They must be stopped, and these families must be empowered to seek accountability in court. Thank you, and I stand ready to support this committee in stopping online platforms for enabling and profiting off of the abuse of children.

Hawley: Thank you very much, Mr. Schlep. Next, we have Mr. Woody Doe. Mr. Doe is a Marine Corps veteran, a husband, a father of four children, who is speaking out to us today about his experience of child sexual exploitation on Roblox. Mr. Doe, thank you for serving our country, and thank you for being here today, the floor is yours.

NAVAL STATION GUANTANAMO BAY, Cuba - At the top of John Paul Jones hill, overlooking the bay, is small, concrete monument. Runners often touch it upon reaching the summit of the hill, but how many have ever stopped to read the plaque on it? If you know where to look and what you are looking for, you’ll notice there are several distinct markers around the Base that bear a particular emblem. This emblem has been the seal of an organization that is the oldest fraternity in the western hemisphere – the Masons. Despite popular culture’s depiction of this group as secretive, subversive and secular, the Caribbean Naval Lodge at Guantanamo Bay is quick to point out that it is charity and wisdom that sets members apart.

“It boils down to relief, charity and brotherly love,” said Richard Vargas, post master for Guantanamo Bay. “You try to associate yourself with like-minded individuals who try to better themselves and the community.”

“Mason means one thing to me, charity,” said Neil Mendoza, database admin for Islands Mechanical, “devoting and giving your time.”

The Masons have been at GTMO since 1965 when the CNL was first established. Service members stationed here, some who were already Masons from various lodges, wanted to have a place where they could continue their traditions and customs.

“It was originally designed as a military lodge, because that’s all you had here at that time, it was a way for them to fellowship with other Masons on an installation,” said Vargas.

The CNL, which falls under the auspices of the Grand Lodge of Ancient, Free and Accepted Masons of Massachusetts, prides itself on benevolence to the GTMO community. Recently, its members assisted the local Boy Scout troop with building a memorial to honor Christopher Columbus.

“The Eagle Scout came to us and asked us for help,” said Vargas, “so we went out and said ‘of course we’ll help you build your project.’ Little by little we’re working on giving back to the community.”

Since the beginning of the CNL, the Masons at GTMO have openly offered Troopers the promise of friendship, brotherhood and charity. The principles and virtues adhered to by the acolytes of this assemblage, according to Vargas, help make the world a better place; not just for the members, but for all who share this world.
